Name: Omelettes (Unofficial Update)
Author: bubu5445
Description:
[center][size=6]原模组：[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15729]Omelettes[/url][/size][/center]

[size=2]我在征求了原作者的同意后，对myAphelion制作的煎蛋卷模组进行了非官方更新。[/size]
[size=2]但是我对于模组的制作还是不太熟练…因此模组存在一些我目前暂时无法解决的问题。[/size]


[center][size=3]所需的模组除了ContentPatcher以外都是可选的，因为它们起到的作用只是使用里面的某些食材，没有安装这些模组只会影响到烹饪，即缺少的那部分食材会显示为错误物品而无法制作，但对应成品在cjb里依然可以正常调用出来。[/size]
[/center]
[center][size=3]而且也会天然缺少“萨拉米香肠”这个食材。因为我里面写的是调用[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/48934]多米尼加烹饪[/url]里的萨拉米香肠，但这个模组被作者下架了。在发布之前，我没有找到可以替代的萨拉米香肠，因此有两个需要这个食材的煎蛋卷目前是无法制作的。[/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][i]♥[/i] [/center]
[center][/center]
[center][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/48934][/url]After obtaining permission from the original author, I released an unofficial update for the Omelettes mod created by myAphelion. However, I’m still not very experienced with modding, so there are some issues I currently can’t resolve.[/center]
[center] [/center]
[center]All required mods other than Content Patcher are optional. Their only purpose is to provide certain ingredients; not installing them will only affect cooking. The missing ingredients will show up as error items and cannot be used for cooking, but the corresponding finished dishes can still be spawned normally via CJB.[/center]
[center] 
Also, the “salami sausage” ingredient will naturally be missing. This is because the mod calls the salami from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/48934]Dominican Cooking CosmicSweetpea[/url] , but that mod has been taken down by its author. Before release, I couldn’t find an alternative salami sausage, so two omelettes that require this ingredient currently cannot be made.[/center]
[center][i]♥[/i] [/center]
Here are the recipes corresponding to these optional mods:
